name: Original synthetic contact intervals
grain: One team per 30-minute interval; 16 intervals daily, 28 days, 3 teams
timezone: Illustrative local time; no real organization implied

definitions.answered_within_30s: Subset of handled; divide by offered for this synthetic service-level contract
definitions.handling_seconds: Total handling seconds; divide by handled for AHT
definitions.answered_wait_seconds: Total waiting seconds for handled contacts; divide by handled for ASA

limitations: Independent synthetic intervals, not cumulative snapshots
Not a validated staffing or arrival-distribution model
